drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 45-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.84, bnp 1861, creatinine 0.71, hemoglobin 12.6, platelets 196, sodium 139, wbc 5.9; vitals dbp 65-69, heart_rate 76-79, map 85-87, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 13-15, sbp 123-126, spo2 96-97, temp 37-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 29%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.74, hemoglobin 12.5, platelets 205, sodium 139, wbc 6.1; vitals dbp 67-70, heart_rate 75-79, map 87-89, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 124-129, spo2 96-97, temp 37-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 45-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
